scope: Physical follow-up only. This protocol adds no physical facts, parameter estimates, or automatic admission.

required_evidence_classes.requirement: Name the physical system, degrees of freedom, native interaction, and a traceable map from the conditional carrier/record to that system.
required_evidence_classes.acceptance: Independent, source-addressed system and mapping evidence; no particle identity inferred from the constructor.

required_evidence_classes.requirement: Measure or independently calibrate energy, time, coupling, and relevant environmental scales with units and uncertainty/covariance.
required_evidence_classes.acceptance: Traceable calibration, uncertainty budget, and model-to-unit conversion; fit-to-target alone is insufficient.

required_evidence_classes.requirement: Specify and validate the preparation, neutral-record analogue, measurement effects, post-readout state, and common reference in the physical apparatus.
required_evidence_classes.acceptance: Calibration and controls demonstrating the same-input comparison can be implemented without changing the rules' shared inputs.

required_evidence_classes.requirement: Derive both rules' physical predictions, detector response, nuisance model, uncertainty propagation, and a preregistered selection/rejection threshold.
required_evidence_classes.acceptance: Predictions distinguish the rules at a declared error rate under independently bounded nuisance parameters.

required_evidence_classes.requirement: Provide an independent protocol review and reproducible data/analysis sufficient to assess selection or rejection.
required_evidence_classes.acceptance: Auditable data and analysis, controls, and independent review; an internal model score is not admission.

admission_policy.required_conclusive_receipt: fresh theorem-specific physical review receipt bound to all evidence digests, system scope, calibrated units, predictions, and preregistered decision rule

outcome_ports.++: physical rule selected/admitted only by the dedicated physical evidence reviewer
outcome_ports.+-: physical admission attempt incomplete/unsuccessful; no rule selected
outcome_ports.-+: physical comparison rejected only with an admitted scoped counterexample/negative result
outcome_ports.--: physical rejection attempt unsuccessful; no inference
